info.title: Meziantou.Framework.HtmlToMarkdown.Tool
info.description: CLI to convert HTML to Markdown using Meziantou.Framework.HtmlToMarkdown

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Convert HTML to Markdown using Meziantou.Framework.HtmlToMarkdown

options.name: --input
options.description: Path to the HTML file to convert. If omitted, reads from stdin

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the Markdown file to write. If omitted, writes to stdout

options.name: --emphasis-marker
options.description: Marker used for emphasis [default: Asterisk]

options.name: --heading-style
options.description: Style used for headings [default: Atx]

options.name: --code-block-style
options.description: Style used for code blocks [default: Fenced]

options.name: --code-block-fence-character
options.description: Fence character used for fenced code blocks [default: `]

options.name: --unordered-list-marker
options.description: Marker used for unordered lists [default: -]

options.name: --thematic-break
options.description: Text used for horizontal rules [default: ---]

options.name: --line-break-style
options.description: Style used for line breaks [default: TrailingSpaces]

options.name: --simple-punctuation
options.description: Convert smart punctuation characters to simple ASCII punctuation

options.name: --emoji-shortcode-mode
options.description: Mode used to convert emoji to shortcodes [default: None]

options.name: --unknown-element-handling
options.description: Handling of unknown HTML elements [default: PassThrough]

options.name: --subscript-style
options.description: Style used for subscript (sub) elements [default: UnknownElement]

options.name: --superscript-style
options.description: Style used for superscript (sup) elements [default: UnknownElement]

options.name: --underline-style
options.description: Style used for underline (u) elements [default: UnknownElement]

options.name: --keyboard-style
options.description: Style used for keyboard input (kbd) elements [default: UnknownElement]

options.name: --embedded-content-style
options.description: Style used for video, audio and iframe elements [default: UnknownElement]

options.name: --ignore-css-white-space
options.description: Collapse the whitespace of the text even when a style attribute preserves it

options.name: --table-span-handling
options.description: Handling of the colspan and rowspan attributes of table cells [default: Ignore]

options.name: --complex-table-handling
options.description: Handling of the tables that a pipe table cannot represent [default: Flatten]

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information
